build_linear_neck_default: build a LinearNeck with default BN1d normalization and no activation layer
build_linear_neck_with_gap: build a LinearNeck with 2D global average pooling for image feature projection
build_linear_neck_with_relu: build a LinearNeck with ReLU activation and LayerNorm for feature transformation
run_linear_neck_forward: run the LinearNeck forward pass on backbone features to get projected output
review_linear_neck_init: review the LinearNeck init to understand gap_dim options and norm layer configuration
